title: Launcher readiness aborts on registration GET ECONNRESET before any test stage
outcome: Diagnose and repair the registration confirmation transport failure that prevented onReady in the preserved UI-bootstrap fixture, using deterministic request-level evidence and the existing registration client owner without deadline inflation or hidden replay.
acceptance: A source and original-artifact diagnosis identifies the failing registration transport path, distinguishes a stale pooled-socket race from server teardown or another cause, and states whether production launcher registration shares the path.

An assertion-first deterministic regression demonstrates the confirmed transport defect and passes with a narrow fix in the existing owner, preserving exact registration identity, total deadline, no-stage-before-confirmation behavior and definitive error handling without unbounded retry or weakened assertions.

Focused transport, launcher-registration and UI-bootstrap regressions pass on the exact final candidate; independent Codex/Claude read-only reviews have no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding; complete source/test/review evidence is handed to Merger for its maintained full gate.
